title: load
description: Payload of `stride load`: the daily series, chronological. `tss`/`ctl`/`atl`/`tsb` are the combined series every sport feeds, and the only source of form. `families` splits fitness by sport family (activities.sport_family: Ride, Run, Rowing, Swim, WeightTraining, ... or the sport_type itself for a sport in no family): the same CTL/ATL recurrence over that family's own scored load, walked over its whole history, so on any day the families' `ctl` sum to the combined `ctl` and their `atl` to the combined `atl`, apart from families left out as below. A family is listed only when it has scored load somewhere in the returned window, and only from its first loaded day on, so a family is ABSENT rather than a zero series that reads as detraining; a family last trained before the window is absent from every row. Families are descriptive and carry no `tsb`.

tss.description: the load this family added that day
